title: 弱读与缩约
goal: 听出弱读的功能词；把缩约形式还原为完整形式。
exam: TOEFL iBT（2026 年 1 月起的新版）· 口语

points.label: 把缩约形式还原为完整形式

body.p: 弱读是不重读的词读得轻而短，拼写和语法作用都不变。缩约是两个词合成一个较短的形式，书面上用撇号标出。弱读的 to 仍是 to；they’ve 对应 they have。

body.box: They've agreed to review the plan.

body.p: 听辨时先记下词序，再看短促的音节在句中的语法位置。弱读的功能词仍在句子里，还原时不能漏掉。重读、单独作答或强调对比时，功能词用强式。

cards.title: 功能词弱读
rows: 不重读、后接辅音时常读 /tə/。
常弱读。/v/ 读得轻，但通常还在。
不重读、连接两个成分时常见。
这里按美音标出 r。对比时用强式。
肯定句中常弱读。否定的 can't 是另一个词形。
作不重读的助动词时常见。作实义动词时一般不弱读。
不重读时常见。单独作答时用强式。
不重读时常见。对比时用强式。

cards.title: 缩约形式
rows: 后接动词原形，表示意愿或假设。
后接过去分词，表示过去完成。
后接过去分词，have 是完成时助动词。
后接动词原形，-ll 是 will。
第一个 had 是助动词，第二个是分词。
I'd had breakfast before the train left.

cards.title: can 与 cannot
rows: 美音的 can't 常读 /kænt/，表示否定。
can't 的 /t/ 常不明显爆破，不能只凭 /t/ 判断。
用前后的分句核对肯定和否定，不只听音量。
I can carry the case, but I can't lift the cabinet.
can't 还原为 cannot，写成一个词。
We can't enter. → We cannot enter.

body.box: I'd packed the cables before the van arrived.

What is the full form of I'd here?
1. I would
2. I had
3. I have
4. I did

body.p: packed 是过去分词，before the van arrived 给出过去的时间点。I’d 是 I had，即第二项。would 后面要接原形 pack，不接 packed。

lines.text: The map of the trail is for the new volunteers.

items.stem: Which pair occurs after map and before the new volunteers?
items.why: map of the trail 中为 of；for the new volunteers 中为 for。

lines.text: The desk and the shelves are ready.

items.stem: Which words connect the objects and introduce ready?
items.why: The desk and the shelves 用 and 连接，are ready 是现在状态。

lines.text: The folder was on the table, and the copies are in the drawer.

items.stem: Which pair gives the two forms of be in order?
items.why: 原句先为 was on the table，后为 are in the drawer；弱读不改变时态和数。

lines.text: I can fold the screen, but I can't carry it alone.

options: Carrying the screen alone but not folding it
Both carrying the screen alone and folding it
Neither folding the screen nor carrying it alone
Folding the screen but not carrying it alone
items.why: can fold 是肯定，can't carry it alone 是否定；两处须分别辨认。

lines.text: I'd checked the label before I sealed the tube.

items.stem: What does the first contraction mean?
items.why: checked 与 before I sealed 表示过去某事之前已完成，I’d 为 I had。

lines.text: They've stored the spare lenses in a padded case.

items.stem: Which full form matches the opening words?
items.why: They’ve stored 是 they have stored；-ve 对应 have。

lines.text: It'll be easier to read the chart in daylight.

items.stem: What is the full form of the opening contraction?
items.why: It’ll be 中 -ll 对应 will，后接原形 be。

lines.text: The sample shouldn't be exposed to direct sunlight.

items.stem: Which expansion preserves the modal and the negative?
items.why: shouldn’t 还原为 should not；其他情态动词改变原句。

lines.text: The carpenter plans to reserve a bench for the apprentice.

items.stem: Which pair occurs before reserve and before the apprentice?
items.why: plans to reserve 中为 to，for the apprentice 中为 for，不能互换。

lines.text: The display contains models of houses and bridges.

items.stem: Which pair occurs after models and after houses?
items.why: models of houses and bridges 中，of 引出模型对象，and 连接 houses 与 bridges。

lines.text: The spare brushes are clean, but the tray was dirty.

items.stem: Which forms of be occur in sentence order?
items.why: brushes are clean 与 tray was dirty 分别用 are 和 was。

lines.text: I can't carry the banner, but I can hold the sign.

items.stem: Which statement preserves the two abilities?
options: The speaker can carry the banner but cannot hold the sign.
The speaker cannot carry the banner but can hold the sign.
The speaker can carry the banner and can hold the sign.
The speaker cannot carry the banner or hold the sign.
items.why: can't carry the banner 与 can hold the sign 是不同的肯否关系，第二项完整保留。

lines.text: I'd prefer to revise the opening paragraph.

items.stem: Which expansion fits the first contraction?
items.why: I’d 后为原形 prefer，因此为 I would prefer，不是 I had。

lines.text: They've measured the depth of each planting hole.

items.stem: Which full form preserves the opening contraction?
items.why: They’ve measured 中 -ve 是 have，构成现在完成时。

lines.text: It'll remain closed until the varnish is dry.

items.stem: What is the full form of the opening contraction?
items.why: It’ll remain 中 -ll 对应 will，后面 remain 为原形。

lines.text: The referee shouldn't restart the match yet.

items.stem: Which expansion preserves the recorded modal?
items.why: shouldn’t restart 中情态动词为 should，否定词 not 必须保留。
